description: Generador de Residuos Peligrosos Industriales. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Cualquier persona natural o jurídica cuya actividad produzca residuos o desechos peligrosos. Si la persona es desconocida será la persona que está en posesión de estos residuos. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Its tags are Generador de Respel, Industrial, Residuo peligroso, Residuo sólido. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2025-12-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
